notes: Statements of this module's helper theorems and of coeff_substF_monomial_continuous_algebraic change in notation only. MvPolynomial is now an abbrev for AddMonoidAlgebra, so the bare `coeff m p` and `MvPolynomial.coeff m p` no longer resolve, and each is written `p.coeff m`. That is the same coefficient of monomial m in p, with identical hypotheses and conclusions. In the proofs, `continuous_finset_sum` is renamed to `continuous_finsetSum`.
